final_message:
Configured the full 13-zone authoritative DNS hierarchy on pc1–pc13, including all 12 delegations, NS glue, service A records, `www.example.com`, and requested MX/A mail records.

pc14 is now a recursive resolver using pc1 as the artificial root; pc16–pc20 use pc14 (`10.14.4.14`) via `resolv.conf`.

Updated only DNS-server images (pc1–pc14) to `kathara/bind`, appended service/resolver startup commands, and preserved topology, addresses, routes, and router configuration.

Static inventory confirms 13 zone files and the requested delegation chain. `named-checkzone`/`named-checkconf` are unavailable on the host, so runtime validation should be done after launching the lab.
